purpose: Bind the accepted Eastmoney balance-sheet transport to one atomic 2019-2025 quarterly monetary-funds snapshot, a three-calendar-day point-in-time event state, capacity-first screening, and seven fixed no-return independence comparisons before any historical provider row, comparison value, price, forward return, aggregation, score, or selection is observed for this branch.

full_source_snapshot_contract.point_in_time_holding_universe_date: the exact report date for each partition
full_source_snapshot_contract.final_partition_format: one immutable parquet per report date
full_source_snapshot_contract.failure_policy: Delete the complete temporary snapshot, publish no final partition, write one terminal no-return source manifest and tracked record, and stop without retrying a date, changing the schema, switching source, inspecting an unused field, running capacity or uniqueness, or reading a price or return.

normalization_contract.valid_monetary_funds: finite, nonnegative, and no greater than total assets
normalization_contract.invalid_row_policy: exclude and count; never fill, clip, absolutize, infer, or substitute another transported field

point_in_time_event_state_contract.individual_value_availability: first local trading-session close strictly after the displayed announcement date
point_in_time_event_state_contract.active_on_session_rule: availability_session <= session and session_date minus announcement_date is at most 3 calendar days

capacity_contract.quality_gate: ROE >= 5%, positive net profit, positive revenue YoY, and positive profit YoY under the existing next-session point-in-time policy

gate_order: revalidate every source-chain and local-context fingerprint plus the accepted factor frame without network
atomically fetch exactly the 27 unobserved report partitions while reusing the accepted 2025-12-31 partition without a provider request
publish only if all 28 partitions pass count completeness, exact schema, formula, identity, coverage, distinct-value, and atomicity gates
freeze the full-source success or terminal failure record
if and only if full-source completeness passes, materialize the three-calendar-day point-in-time state and run capacity without any comparison value, price, or return
if and only if capacity passes, load exactly the seven predeclared comparison factors and run uniqueness without any forward return
freeze a separate one-time three-session return, execution, and CNY 200,000 pilot diagnostic only if every no-return gate passes
prohibited_actions: change provider, endpoint, report, source positions, schema fingerprint, report dates, factor, direction, availability timing, age, invalid-row policy, universe, coverage, capacity, comparison catalog, or uniqueness threshold
inspect or persist receivables, inventory, liabilities, payables, prepaid accounts, equity, growth, or any other unused transported balance-sheet field
publish a partial snapshot, resume a partial snapshot, retry any full-source failure, or rescue the branch with a new denominator or transform
read a raw price or forward return, aggregate with another factor, current-score, select, size, order, or use Level-2 before every no-return gate passes
